settings.voice: audio prompt dia_prompt_kokoro_am_puck.wav: "Okay, so you're not gonna believe this one, but it's totally true. I looked it up like three times, because I honestly thought it was a joke."

final_transcript: A bear served in the army and carried ammo. In 1942, Polish soldiers in Iran adopted a bear cub named Wojtek. He loved beer, wrestling, and long showers. To ship him to Italy, the army listed him as a soldier. At Monte Cassino, he reportedly carried crates of artillery shells. His unit's badge became a bear carrying a shell.
